description: The chart illustrates performance values for a model labeled “Flan-T5-783M” across six dataset/setting categories, shown as paired bars per category. The horizontal axis contains the categories in left-to-right order: “TriviaQA (EM),” “HotPotQA (EM),” “2Wiki (EM),” “TriviaQA (F1),” “HotPotQA (F1),” and “2Wiki (F1),” with no explicit axis title; the vertical axis is a numeric scale (linear) with labeled ticks at approximately 25, 45, 65, and 85, spanning roughly from 25 to 85. Each category has two adjacent bars: a blue bar and a red bar, with values printed on the bars. For “TriviaQA (EM),” the blue bar is about 77.3 and the red bar about 77.1; for “HotPotQA (EM),” blue is about 37.0 and red about 31.9; for “2Wiki (EM),” blue is about 44.5 and red about 32.5; for “TriviaQA (F1),” blue is about 82.8 and red about 83.8; for “HotPotQA (F1),” blue is about 49.7 and red about 43.3; and for “2Wiki (F1),” blue is about 53.3 and red about 38.1. The tallest bar shown is the red bar for “TriviaQA (F1)” at about 83.8, and the shortest is the red bar for “HotPotQA (EM)” at about 31.9; bars are not visually sorted by height, and there are no additional annotations beyond the value labels and the color legend.
